# About This Volume {.unnumbered .unlisted}

This is **Volume 2 of 3** of *Biostatistics Practicum*. The book is
also published whole, as a single continuously numbered site, at
<https://practicum.rgtlab.org>; the print edition is split into
three volumes only because one bound book would exceed a comfortable
page count.

**This volume** covers Parts IV, VII, and VIII: documents and
environments (Quarto, renv, Docker, compendium assembly, targets,
cloud compute), the two worked case studies (Palmer Penguins and
ADNI), ethics, communicating a finished analysis, federal
requirements, and the capstone. It also carries the book's full
reference apparatus: the glossary, cheat sheets, the instructor
guide, the rgtlab software appendix, the tooling-as-of appendix, the
R Markdown migration guide, interactive deliverables, credits, and
the colophon. These appendices are kept here, in one place, rather
than duplicated in all three volumes.

**Volume 1**, *Why, Toolkit, and Data*, covers why reproducible
research matters, team science, de-identification, the toolkit, and
working with data. It comes before this volume.

**Volume 3**, *Industry Practice*, covers statistical analysis
plans, testing and continuous integration, and the pharmaceutical
industry chapters (CDISC and SAS); the one-quarter supplement for
pharmaceutical-track students.

Cross-references within this volume work as usual. A reference to
material in another volume is written as plain text, for example
'Chapter 1 (Why Reproducible Research) in Volume 1', since a printed
volume cannot link into a book it is not bound with.
